comment: M05 alpha gate: real cities on RWG2 Continents, seed 4242. Each shot's position and view come from /lostcities find (decision log D-M05J-17); the monument is the one city.sewing finds near chunk (-4096, 4096).
title: Alpha review: real cities on RWG2 Continents, seed 4242

shots.name: above
shots.caption: City from above: the city nearest the spawn, from south of its center, looking north.

shots.name: street
shots.caption: Street level: the primary street nearest the spawn with open street ahead, from head height.

shots.name: interior
shots.caption: Building interior: the ground floor of the building nearest the spawn, looking toward its street door.

shots.name: edge
shots.caption: City edge: where the city meets RWG2 terrain, from just above the land outside it, looking into the city.

shots.name: village
shots.caption: Village sewn into the city: the lane or link from the city toward a VillageNames village, from the south.

shots.name: reserved
shots.caption: Reserved lot: the edge ring the city leaves around a VillageNames village, from the south.

shots.name: softedge
shots.caption: Soft edge: the strip where the city slopes to a village's natural ground instead of a wall, from above the rooftops.

shots.name: monument
shots.caption: Kept clear: the ocean monument at chunk (-4213, 3917), its landmark core left to VillageNames. No city reaches it on this seed; the core is reserved all the same.
